latest.name: Vizard — AI Video Repurposing & Clip Maker
latest.short_verdict: Vizard repurposes long videos such as podcasts, interviews and webinars into short social clips by finding highlight moments, adding captions and reframing the footage. Its Free plan gives 60 credits each month (the help centre defines one credit as one minute processed), plus the editor and AI clipping. The trade-offs are a watermark, 720p exports, a 10-minute export cap and three-day project retention. It is useful for evaluating a repurposing workflow, but the free output is not clean, permanent client-ready production.
latest.what_it_does: Vizard is a browser-based AI video repurposing editor. Users upload a video or paste a supported video link; its AI identifies candidate highlights, creates short clips, adds subtitles, reframes footage for vertical or other social formats, and provides an editor for trimming and polishing. It is aimed at turning existing long-form recordings—podcasts, interviews, webinars, tutorials and livestreams—into short-form social content, rather than generating an entirely new video from scratch.
latest.why_try_it: It can save the manual work of scrubbing a long recording to find shareable moments, then preparing separate crops and captions for Shorts, Reels or TikTok. The free allowance is enough to test the workflow on a few short source videos before deciding whether its clip selection and editing style fit a creator's needs.
latest.free_tier: The official pricing page lists Free at $0 with 60 credits per month, AI-generated clips, full access to the video editor, a private workspace, one connected social account and 720p exports. Vizard's help centre defines 1 credit as 1 minute of video processed for AI clipping or transcription; it says the same project is charged only once if both are used. On that documented baseline, 60 credits represent about 60 minutes of source footage per month.
latest.limits: The Free comparison table caps source uploads at 60 minutes and 1 GB, allows 1080p source uploads, caps exports at 720p and 10 minutes, and provides three-day project storage. Vizard's help centre confirms that free exports carry a Vizard.ai watermark and projects expire after three days. Download wanted clips promptly. AI-selected moments and captions still need human review; an independent hands-on review found occasional caption errors and imperfect subject centering during reframing. Do not treat it as a full multi-track professional editor.
latest.signup_pakistan: The public signup and pricing pages reviewed did not state a Pakistan-specific prohibition. They show Google sign-in and email/password signup, and the Free plan does not require a paid checkout. However, signup from Pakistan was not hands-on tested, and the public pages do not confirm regional payment acceptance. Vizard lists cards, PayPal, Stripe and bank transfers generally; acceptance of Pakistani-issued cards and any local bank fees remain unverified. The official Google Play listing was verified, but its availability in the Pakistan Play Store was not confirmed.
latest.quality_evidence: Vendor evidence: Vizard's official product page documents highlight extraction, automatic captions, reframing and social-format editing; its pricing and help pages specify the free limits. Independent hands-on evidence: CreatorIntelHQ describes testing signup, upload, clipping, captions, reframing, editor access, downloads and watermark behaviour on short and 10-minute 1080p footage in August 2026. The reviewer found captions mostly correct but with some word errors, and said 9:16 reframing did not always keep the speaker centred; the review discloses affiliate links. Anecdotal feedback: the official Google Play listing showed 4.4/5 from about 8.57K reviews and 100K+ downloads when checked; individual reviews include both praise for the free workflow and complaints about slow processing. Store ratings and individual comments are not controlled quality tests. This report did not perform a hands-on generation test.

The Google Play listing showed 4.4/5 from about 8.57K reviews, 100K+ downloads and an update dated 3 November 2026 when checked. Pakistan-specific Play Store availability was not confirmed.
